bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
new=create-videobot:video-dualmode-button-download-dc4578de
old=create-videobot:pre-video-dualmode-dc4578de
mask=0
actual="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}' 2>/dev/null || true)"
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}' 2>/dev/null)" = true && mask=$((mask+1)) || true
test "$actual" = "$(docker image inspect "$old" --format '{{.Id}}' 2>/dev/null)" && mask=$((mask+2)) || true
test "$actual" = "$(docker image inspect "$new" --format '{{.Id}}' 2>/dev/null)" && mask=$((mask+4)) || true
test "$actual" = "$(docker image inspect create-videobot:local-poll --format '{{.Id}}' 2>/dev/null)" && mask=$((mask+8)) || true
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll -q | wc -l)" -eq 1 && mask=$((mask+16)) || true
docker logs "$cid" 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS' && mask=$((mask+32)) || true
docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq 'createVideoInvoiceSalesFlow' /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs 2>/dev/null && mask=$((mask+64)) || true
exit $((100+mask))
